subject.title: fix(claude-cli): max-turn stops omit run and recovery context

question: Should a Claude CLI max-turn terminal result always stop auth-profile rotation and configured model fallback when tool actions may already have occurred?
rationale: Both behaviors are implementable, but choosing duplicate-side-effect prevention over the user's configured automatic fallback is a product compatibility decision rather than a mechanical correctness question.

options.title: Stop all replay
options.body: Surface the actionable terminal error immediately and require the user to verify tool effects before retrying.

options.title: Preserve configured fallback
options.body: Keep automatic profile and model fallback, accepting that another attempt may repeat tool actions from the terminated Claude run.

recommendation.title: Stop all replay
recommendation.body: Surface the actionable terminal error immediately and require the user to verify tool effects before retrying.

likelyOwner.reason: The current history snapshot covers both shared fallback layers and the final user-facing delivery decision.
